overall_goal: Fry the potatoes in oil, add salt, and stir frequently while splitting chunks to check doneness

goals.description: Prepare the frying pan and add oil
goals.rationale: The person dries the frying pan, places it on the hob, and pours olive oil into it.

goals.description: Retrieve salt and lid, and clear space
goals.rationale: The person gets salt from the cupboard, a lid, and moves items on the counter to make space.

goals.description: Add salt to the potatoes and stir
goals.rationale: The person sprinkles salt onto the potatoes in the pan and stirs them to distribute the salt evenly.

goals.description: Stir the potatoes and cover with lid
goals.rationale: The person stirs the potatoes and places a glass lid on the frying pan to prevent oil from spilling.

goals.description: Stir the potatoes, lower the heat, and return spilled chunks
goals.rationale: The person stirs the potatoes, lowers the hob heat, and picks up a spilled potato chunk to return it to the pan.

goals.description: Stir the potatoes, lower the heat again, and tap the spatula
goals.rationale: The person continues stirring, lowers the heat further, returns another spilled chunk, and taps the spatula to remove stuck bits.

goals.description: Stir the potatoes and return spilled chunks
goals.rationale: The person stirs the potatoes and carefully returns multiple spilled potato chunks back into the frying pan.

goals.description: Stir the potatoes and split chunks to check doneness
goals.rationale: The person stirs the potatoes and uses the spatula to split chunks to see if they are cooked.

goals.description: Continue stirring and splitting potato chunks
goals.rationale: The person continues to stir the potatoes and split more chunks to check if they are well cooked.
